entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's so hoooooot...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: There's a lot of people here... Are you[n]okay, Futaba?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I'm fine. You guys are here.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It's almost lunchtime.

entries.speaker: Woman in a Swimsuit
entries.en: Nooo, the squid's staring at me.

entries.speaker: Man in a Swimsuit
entries.en: It's cooked, so don't worry. Would you[n]even eat squid if I'm not around?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Why don't we eat lunch too?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I'll go get some stuff for us then.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You're eating that even here!?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: My staple food.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: This should be a familiar flavor, yet how[n]does it taste so good?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What's up Makoto? You ain't eatin' much.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh, um...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Not feelin' well or somethin'?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You just don't get it, do you, Ryuji?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: When a girl's in a swimsuit, she wants to[n]look as slim as possible.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Still, you're worrying too much. Did you[n]make sure to eat breakfast?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Mona lacks tact.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So, whadda we do now? Should we play[n]some beach volleyball?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh, sorry. Us girls already made plans to[n]ride a banana boat.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We could only rent a three-person one.[n]Sorry.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wait... Then what about us?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Keep an eye on our stuff.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hell no! Why you gotta treat us like that!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We're celebrities makin' headlines![n]You should treat us better!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I do think they're not bad in the[n]Metaverse, but in reality... Strange,[n]isn't it?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: They can steal treasures, but they don't[n]seem like they can steal a girl's heart[n]at all.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: B-But... Lady Ann...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Can we get to the banana boat already?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh, sorry. We'll go now.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We'll switch when we're done. Keep an[n]eye on our stuff for us!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dammit... They don't get how amazin'[n]we are.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We risk our lives bein' Phantom Thieves.[n]There's no way we're the same as other[n]guys around here.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Shouldn't we be havin' more good times[n]in reality too!?
You have a point.
You're full of yourself.
I don't care.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Right? Don't you agree, Yusuke?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: No, we're special. Don't you agree,[n]Yusuke?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We're special, man. Don't you agree,[n]Yusuke?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Well... if you put it that way, you may be[n]right.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ann and the others don't get it 'cause[n]they're always around us.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, how do we get Lady Ann to notice[n]how amazing we are as Phantom Thieves?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well, we gotta steal... you-know-what.
Treasure?
Hearts?
Swimsuits?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That's our job in the Metaverse. What[n]we're gonna steal in reality are... girls'[n]hearts.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ann made fun of us and all. Let's show[n]her what we're really made of.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You moron, that's a crime. What we're[n]gonna steal in reality are... girls' hearts.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I see. I just need to prove my skills in[n]reality as well...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Let's steal all the hearts with the skills[n]we've honed as Phantom Thieves!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I'm sure girls will be all over us,[n]considering the vibes we give off!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Very well, let's do this. Pulling off our[n]work in reality doesn't sound bad.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's settled then.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So... Mona, you're in charge of watching[n]over our stuff, okay?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Huh?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: All right, let's hurry up and go.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey what the hell! Get back here![n]Don't leave me behind!
